title: CS 6120: Advanced Compilers: The Self-Guided Online Course (2020)
summary: Cornell's CS 6120 is a graduate-level advanced compilers course made freely available as a self-guided online resource, covering program analysis, compiler optimizations, IR design, and modern compilation techniques used in industry.
problem_solved: Democratizes access to high-quality compiler education by making Cornell's graduate-level systems course available for self-study to anyone worldwide.
why_valuable: Provides Ivy League-quality compiler curriculum for free, enabling developers to understand how compilers work under the hood and write more efficient code.
